subject.title: Feature request: Add CarPlay support to the official iOS app

question: Should OpenClaw pursue official iOS CarPlay support now, and if so which Apple category, entitlement/provisioning path, and constrained Talk UX should the app target?
rationale: The requested behavior is a new official app surface with signing, release, and driving-safety constraints; source inspection shows no existing CarPlay implementation or simple missing toggle that automation can repair.

options.title: Keep and scope CarPlay
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical request and ask iOS owners to define the category, entitlement plan, and minimal Talk-only UX before code starts.

options.title: Fold into mobile RFC
options.body: Move the idea into the broader mobile design process if maintainers want CarPlay evaluated alongside other platform-specific mobile directions first.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide CarPlay entitlement, review, or safety constraints make it out of scope for the official app in the near term.

recommendation.title: Keep and scope CarPlay
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical request and ask iOS owners to define the category, entitlement plan, and minimal Talk-only UX before code starts.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion explicitly routed the feature request to this handle, and their merged iOS realtime Talk work is the closest existing voice-first implementation surface.
